test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 07 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the bracketed words to fill in the blank.

The lights ________ (lighting up) the artwork on the walls of the museum were looking beautiful.
solution:
The correct answer is **"illuminating".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• A word **synonymous** with another word is known as a **synonym** **(or nearly the same meaning)**.
 
• To **"light up"** something is to **make it brighter by adding light or color.**
 
• **"Illuminating" **means to (formally) **enlighten anything to shed light on it.**
 
• Therefore, the appropriate synonym for **"lighting up"** is **"Illuminating".**

**​Correct sentence : **The lights **i**____**lluminating**__ (lighting up) the artwork on the walls of the museum were looking beautiful.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** Let's discuss the other options.

 
• **Enlightening:** **Enlightening** is the **provision of, or a tendency to supply, information, comprehension, or insight**.
 
• **Trafficking: Trafficking** is the **illicit purchase and sale of goods or people**.
 
• **Mesmerising :** To thoroughly captivate **someone's interest or attention** is to be **mesmerising.**
